name: Questioning Reethe

intro: Ogron, whom Krog sent to track the human Reethe, has found him at last after a long search and says he hid well for a human. Ogron worries that so much time in the swamp may have driven Reethe mad, and asks you to come along to get answers from him. Afterward the way leads back to Krog at Brackenwall Village.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It took a long time, but I found Reethe. He hide good for a human.
Ogron worried that he might be crazy after so much time in swamp. You come with me for we go get answers from him.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmph. It is good that Reethe will no longer be lurking around the swamp, but it is a shame that humans are built so frail that he could not recover from a little arrow wound.
It seems that this thread of the mystery has led nowhere, and we must look elsewhere.
